name: task-inline
title: Task Inline
description: A task in running text — one round box (its done state), the title that opens its peek, the assignee's avatar, a due chip and ↗ to its page on hover — plus MakeTaskPopover, which makes that task from a checklist line in place, with the host's assignee, due and space pickers in slots.

meta.whenToUse: A checklist line linked to a task, or a task named in running text, where the reader ticks it, opens it and sees who and when; MakeTaskPopover to make one from a line.
meta.whenNotToUse: A task row in a list or board (DataList, BoardCard) or a plain reference to a task in a sentence (InlineChip).
